title: Concept: Frame loaded over plaintext HTTP
description: An iframe that points at plaintext HTTP in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The framed page is not protected by the bank's transport, so a network attacker controls what appears inside the bank's own layout.
applicability: Deployments that render an iframe that points at plaintext HTTP into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The framed page is not protected by the bank's transport, so a network attacker controls what appears inside the bank's own layout.
